title: BasedInv
description: A starting inventory for servers. Lets you edit configs to have a first join and a respawn inventory!
body:
Adds the ability to give players a starting inventory on your server!
Edit YML files and give them awesome stuff!
Super lightweight and simple :)

To install just drag it into your plugins folder
Edit the YML files it generates after starting up to give players items, with a bunch of parameters :O

Run 
```
/bi reload
/basedinv reload
```
to load new config files

Permissions:

```
basedinv.admin - Lets you run BasedInv admin commands
```
